name: tifa-bundle-testdata
description: npm packages the internal/bundle tests bundle: React for the trimmed renderer, seroval (1.6.9, and 1.8.1 under the alias seroval-1-8-1) and core-js for the adapters, @emotion/hash for the hash in Go, i18next for its translations (26.5.3, and 27.0.0 and 27.0.1 under the aliases i18next-27-0-0 and i18next-27-0-1), lucide-react (1.58.0, and 1.75.0 under the alias lucide-react-1-75-0) for the cache of its icons, react-i18next for the copy of its i18n object, rehype-highlight for its lowlight, @radix-ui/react-slot for the merge of its props, @mui/material and @mui/system with emotion for memoTheme, the other SSR host patches, Vite with the React plugin, which build them, and the unified packages that turn Markdown into HTML, with rehype-slug to compare the heading ids with.
